description: The line plot titled "Abstractive summarization from Audio Transcription" illustrates the performance of different models in terms of ROUGE scores, which are used to evaluate the quality of text summarization. The x-axis represents the logarithm of the number of tokens in the reference summary, ranging from 0 to 8, with a tick label interval of 1. The y-axis measures the ROUGE scores, ranging from 0 to 35, with a tick label interval of 5. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different model configuration. The T5 + LoRA model is represented by a red line, the MBart + LoRA model by a purple line, the T5 + AdaLoRA model by a green line, and the MBart + AdaLoRA model by an orange line. The T5 + LoRA model shows a relatively stable performance with slight fluctuations, maintaining scores between approximately 25 and 30. The MBart + LoRA model starts with a low score of around 5, then increases sharply to reach a score of about 30. The T5 + AdaLoRA model shows a steady increase, starting from around 25 and reaching a score of about 30. The MBart + AdaLoRA model also shows a steady increase, starting from around 5 and reaching a score of about 30. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions about the cause of changes in the scores.
